newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares seen starting with a jump.
newsitem.headline: French shares seen starting with a jump.

text.p: French shares were seen jumping at the open on Tuesday, with the May future indicated one percent higher at 2,712, on the back of a strong Wall Street gain.

The Dow Jones index stormed to a record close on higher oil prices and a slide in the dollar. A lower dollar is usually negative for French shares while a higher oil price is set to boost majors such as Elf Aquitaine and Total.

A new BVA opinion poll on the French election showed a win for the ruling centre-right coalition. Fund managers see CAC up to 3,000 if government wins, down to 2,400 if Socialists win May 25, June 1 parliamentary election.
Alcatel Alsthom reported a 12.1 percent increase in first quarter sales to 40.1 billion francs but slight drop in orders.
Usinor said its first quarter sales were down by 2.2 percent to 18.42 billion francs.
On Monday, the CAC-40 index closed with a 2.25 percent gain at 2,693.09. Its all time high, recahed on March 11, 1997, stands at 2,736.71.
